sections.content: You know the time words of this unit: *hoy*, *esta mañana* and *esta tarde*; *esta semana*, *este mes* and *este año*; *hasta ahora*, *últimamente*, *ya* and *todavía no*. They all go with the *pretérito perfecto*. The story of the boat trip at Tam Cốc uses several of them together.

items.spanish: Esta mañana hemos llegado al embarcadero.
items.english: This morning we have arrived at the pier.

items.spanish: Hasta ahora hemos visto lugares muy bonitos.
items.english: So far we have seen very beautiful places.

items.spanish: Todavía no hemos probado la comida típica.
items.english: We have not tried more typical food yet.

items.spanish: Las vacaciones han empezado de la mejor manera posible.
items.english: The holidays have started in the best possible way.

rows: esta semana, este mes, este año
hasta ahora, últimamente, ya, todavía no

sections.content: Choose the time word, then build the verb: *he / has / ha / hemos / han* + participle. Times that are already over need another past tense, which you will learn in Unit 11.
